verdict.rationale: Unreal documents a public Remote Control API: a web server inside the engine accepts HTTP and WebSocket requests through a REST-like interface, can call any Blueprint-callable function, and has its own HTTP and WebSocket reference pages. Python editor scripting and command-line/UAT automation add further documented programmatic control, and a probe confirms these API docs are fetchable keylessly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents drive the engine through these APIs in practice, and a remotely reachable API, since Remote Control runs locally on the same network as the engine host.
